optional_cpu_owner_diagnostics.delta_rules: Pair only same session and taskNumber with available=1,known=1,conflict=0,stale=0 at both samples; require non-regressing runUs and ordered non-overlapping t0Us/t1Us brackets. Never compare across boot, map unknown to zero, or infer current CPU from stale samples.
optional_cpu_owner_diagnostics.counter_scope: switch_out accumulator; current running slice omitted, ISR may be included, SDK not isolated, blocked time unknown; collector does not derive CPU percentages
